verdict.rationale: Sift documents a 0–100 risk score. It also documents Workflows, a rules automation platform for real-time risk-based decisions, along with Review Queues and custom Decisions tied to backend actions. Together these imply that score-based routing to allow, review or block is configurable, but the evidence never explicitly shows threshold-to-action mapping. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of score-range thresholds mapped to actions, any 3DS step-up action, threshold-tuning guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map score ranges to actions — allow, review, block, step-up 3DS — and tune thresholds to my own risk appetite instead of a fixed cutoff

citations.quote: Sift represents this risk with a score between 0 and 100, where risky events have higher scores.
Workflows enable you to make risk-based decisions in real time during key events. Follow this guide to create your own custom Workflow.
Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.
